name: Lockheed Martin F-22A Raptor

published.source: USAF F-22A fact sheet: 62 ft 1 in long, 44 ft 6 in span, 16 ft 8 in high. stealth_n DRAWS a 13.20 m span on purpose (js/hero/us_f22_raptor.js THE SPAN: the airbase revetments at r 16); nato_e00_fighter draws the true 13.56 m

reference_note: Batch 5: no picture could be fetched (Wikimedia answered HTTP 429 to every request during the session), so the spec has no outline references; the landmarks below are the published figures and the drawing's numbers as the model header records them. A later pass should add the 3-view (plan exact, side advisory) under specs/ref/stealth_n/.
must_show: clipped-diamond wing: LE swept 42 deg, TE swept FORWARD 17 deg, the tip's trailing corner cut back at 42 deg; drawn half-span y +-6.60 (true 6.78), tip LE about s 12.3 (x -2.9)
diamond stabilators right behind the wing, LE 42 deg from s 15.81 at y 3.0, the cranked TE whose aftmost point is a third of the way out (y about 2.95, s 18.92, x -9.46)
twin fins canted 28 deg out from y +-1.55 at the boom shoulder (h 2.10), LE swept 22.9 deg from s 13.1 (x -3.64), TE swept forward to the rudder over the nozzles, tips at z 3.13 (h 5.08)
two flat 2-D vectoring nozzles side by side on the centreline pair at the tail, s 17.0-17.9 (x -7.5..-8.4), dark flap seams and sidewall plates
caret intakes 1.83 m off the centreline (y +-1.83), mouth at s 4.75 (x 4.71), the lip swept back 49 deg in plan, lower lip behind the upper, dark duct inside
long frameless bubble canopy with the gold indium-tin-oxide tint, top about h 3.03 (z 1.08) near s 4.0, over the chined forebody
a wide flat body about 4.5 m across from the intakes to the tail (chine y +-2.28 at s 9.6)

everything internal: main bay on the belly s 7.2-11.9 (x 2.26..-2.44) and the side bays low on the trunks s 6.2-8.7, drawn shut with saw-toothed door outlines; the M61A2 door over the starboard trunk at s 7.85
tricycle gear: nose wheel at s 5.72 (x 3.74), mains at s 11.82 (x -2.36), saw-toothed gear doors

plain two-tone grey paint, the darker disruptive blotches, saw-toothed panel seams; low-visibility star insignia on the upper port wing at s 12.0 y 4.9, the lower starboard wing and both intake trunks (kept: the owner's decision); team colour only on the tips and edge bands
